```{python}
import html
import json
from pathlib import Path

import plotly.express as px
import polars as pl
from great_tables import GT
from IPython.display import display

study = json.loads(Path("study.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
thresholds = pl.read_csv("thresholds.csv")
languages = pl.read_csv("languages.csv")


def show(frame):
    table = GT(frame)
    strings = [name for name, dtype in frame.schema.items() if dtype == pl.String]
    if strings:
        table = table.fmt(html.escape, columns=strings)
    display(table)
```

## Measurement audit

Provider-call latency, complete-operation wall time, scheduler wait, cache state,
and collection condition are separate measurements. Existing saved timings are
not relabeled as controlled live evidence.

## Historical exploratory values

Historical runs supplied the immutable predictions used by this simulation.
Their request timings were collected at different times and are excluded from
controlled latency acceptance decisions.

## Offline threshold simulation

All thresholds use aligned validation records. The locked test set is not used.

```{python}
if thresholds.is_empty():
    print("No thresholds were evaluated.")
else:
    show(thresholds.filter(pl.col("non_dominated")).select(
        "threshold", "macro_f1", "fallback_fraction", "jev_coverage",
        "cost_usd_per_1000", "qualifies_quality", "qualifies_languages"
    ))
    px.line(thresholds, x="jev_coverage", y="macro_f1", hover_data=["threshold"],
            title="Risk-quality coverage curve").show(renderer="notebook")
    px.line(thresholds, x="fallback_fraction", y="macro_f1", hover_data=["threshold"],
            title="Macro F1 versus fallback rate").show(renderer="notebook")
    priced = thresholds.filter(pl.col("cost_usd_per_1000").is_not_null())
    if not priced.is_empty():
        px.scatter(priced, x="cost_usd_per_1000", y="macro_f1", color="non_dominated",
                   hover_data=["threshold", "fallback_fraction"],
                   title="Validation cost-quality frontier").show(renderer="notebook")
        px.line(priced, x="threshold", y="fallback_fraction",
                title="Threshold versus fallback rate").show(renderer="notebook")
```

## Conditional risk

```{python}
if not thresholds.is_empty():
    show(thresholds.select("threshold", "accepted_error_rate", "deferred_error_rate"))
```

## Controlled live measurements

No controlled live measurements are included unless a separately authorized,
completed benchmark is attached. P50/P90/P95/P99, ECDF, throughput-latency, and
quality-P95-cost charts remain unavailable for this offline-only report.

## Language slices

```{python}
if languages.is_empty():
    print("No language rows are available.")
else:
    show(languages)
    px.line(languages, x="threshold", y="macro_f1", color="language",
            title="Macro F1 by language").show(renderer="notebook")
    px.line(languages, x="threshold", y="jev_coverage", color="language",
            title="Jev coverage by language").show(renderer="notebook")
```

## Recommendation status

```{python}
print(html.escape(study["recommendation_status"]))
print("Candidate thresholds:", ", ".join(f"{value:.2f}" for value in study["candidate_thresholds"]))
```

Candidate policies come from validation quality and cost simulation. A final
operating recommendation requires controlled matched latency evidence.

## Limitations

Bootstrap intervals are paired by record, not by latent template cluster. P99 is
descriptive for small pilots. Missing costs and timings remain unknown. Sequential
fallback adds OpenAI latency to deferred requests, and no final-test claim is made.
